DEEPSPACE

How to Play

Choose a patrol system and a ship, then pick your loadout. Scout is agile, Cruiser is balanced, and Battleship has the most armor.

Close Range improves your next shot but gives the enemy a better shot, too. Phasers work at any range. Special weapons have limited ammunition. Pull Back to increase distance, or Disengage to end the patrol.
